title: HL7 v2 to FHIR hard case manifest (case.yaml)
description: Manifest of one case under cases/<NNN>-<short-slug>/. A case with status 'todo' may omit most fields and may have no accepted answers; a case with status 'ready' must be complete.

id.description: Must equal the case folder name: a three-digit number and a short slug.

status.description: 'todo': work in progress, accepted_answers may be empty and message.hl7 may be missing. 'ready': complete.

summary.description: What the case contains and why it is hard.

v2_version.description: HL7 v2 version as in MSH-12, e.g. '2.5.1'. Quote it in YAML.

trigger_event.description: Trigger event as declared in MSH-9.2. If other fields disagree (e.g. EVN-1), say so in the summary.

hop.description: 'v2-to-enterprise' should be lossless and gets a strict diff. 'enterprise-to-repository' is lossy by design.

initiates_workflow.description: Declared by the case, not inferred: whether the message initiates a workflow (e.g. a Task).

validation.description: What a pass covers. Two tools can both say 'pass' after validating different things.

packages.description: Pinned package set. Exact versions only, never 'latest', 'current' or ranges.

snomed_edition.description: SNOMED CT edition module id, e.g. '900000000000207008' (International), or an edition/version URI such as 'http://snomed.info/sct/900000000000207008/version/20250101'. Quote it in YAML.

scope.description: What was validated. 'bundle-and-entries': the Bundle including all its entries.

accepted_answers.description: One entry per accepted answer. More than one is normal; each states its rationale and the exchange pattern it serves.

declared_losses.description: Information the conversion is expected to drop, and why. An empty list states that nothing is lost.

source.description: e.g. 'EVN-1', or a FHIR path for the enterprise-to-repository hop.

attachments.description: Embedded attachments. The original binary is stored under attachments/ and its SHA-256 is recorded here.

segment_field.description: Where the attachment is embedded, e.g. 'OBX-5'.

occurrence.description: 1-based occurrence of that segment in the message. Default 1.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the original bytes.

scrubbing_method.description: Required when provenance is 'scrubbed': how identifying data was removed or replaced.
